content.title: Kentucky basketball vs Santa Clara NCAA Tournament: Recap and results
content.text: Updated March 20, 2026, 10:39 p.m. ETThe season was over for the Kentucky Wildcats basketball team. With a little more than two seconds remaining, Santa Clara buried a 3-pointer that gave it a 73-70 lead, and seemingly put a disappointing season to bed for Big Blue Nation.But those two-plus seconds were just enough time for a miracle.Otega Oweh took the inbounds pass and drained a half-court jumper that tied the game and sent it to overtime. Once there, the Wildcats pulled ahead and pulled away to win 89-84 in the wildest game of the NCAA Tournament so far.Oweh was spectacular. Aside from the miracle heave, he made 11-of-24 shots and totaled 35 points while grabbing 8 rebounds. He had 7 assists. Brandon Garrison was the other hero for Kentucky. In overtime, he had back-to-back blocked shots on 3-point attempts that led to baskets down the stretch. He scored 10 points, 7 rebounds and 6 blocks.Kentucky will likely face a very good Iowa State team in the second round and will need to play much better overall. This one will be remembered for a long time, though. Highlight: Otega Oweh miracle Final: Kentucky 89 - Santa Clara 84Otega Oweh and Brandon Garrison played the heros. Kentucky is on to face Iowa State. Kentucky advancesIt took a miracle shot and overtime, but the Wildcats move on. Brandon Garrison blocks another threeIn an exact replay, Garrison gets up and blocks the 3-point attempt, and Kentucky takes a six-point lead. Brandon Garrison blockGarrison gets up and blocks the 3-point attempt, then gets the breakaway dunk. It's 83-79, Wildcats with 48 seconds left. Otega Oweh free throws give Kentucky the leadIt's a two-point game after Oweh makes two from the line. Santa Clara red hot from threeThe Broncos shooters aren't missing from deep. It's tied at 79. Mouhamed Dioubate for twoThe Wildats take a one-point lead on a Dioubate layup. Otega Oweh!!!!!!!!!The season appeared to be over. Santa Clara made a 3-pointer with just about two seconds remaining to take the lead by three. Oweh took the inbounds pass and heaved it from almost halfcourt and it's good. We've got overtime. Santa Clara in front with another offensive reboundA 3-point attempt misses everything, but the Broncos get the miss and put it in. They lead 70-68. Santa Clara back to the leadOtega Oweh took a poor shot and the Broncos are back in front by one. Kentucky gives up another offensive reboundThe Wildcats big men continue to get pushed under the basket and then give up offensive boards. Santa Clara heads to the free throw line. Kam Williams hits from deepIt's a back and forth game. Williams hits a 3 to put the Cats back in front by one. Otega Oweh gets out frontKentucky takes the lead back after Oweh gets a 3-point play in transition. Kentucky down by fourThe Wildcats trail by four points with under 10 minutes to play. Santa Clara is heating up from the deep. Santa Clara back to the leadEvery time Kentucky gets ahead, it gives up a run. The Broncos are back in front by a point. Otega Oweh misses a dunkOweh drove to the rim, but it didn't go, and Santa Clara retakes possession. Highlight: Brandon Garrison big time dunk Media timeout: Kentucky 51 - Santa Clara 47The Wildcats extended the lead to seven points, but the Broncos get a wide open 3-point look and buried it. Brandon Garrison throws it downA defensive lapse left Garrison with a clear path to the basket and he hammers down a big dunk. Highlight: Denzel Aberdeen hits the 3 Media timeout: Kentucky 46 - Santa Clara 44The game has lived up to the hype so far. Neither team has been able to pull away, and the lead has changed hands several times. Kentucky still taking too many early threesBoth Otega Oweh and Collin Chandler have already taken 3-point shots early in the clock without running any offense, giving away a possession. It's 46-44 Kentucky. Collin Chandler from threeChandler finally gets a 3-pointer to fall, and puts the Wildcats back in front. Collin Chandler steal and dunkChandler ties the game. He forces the turnover and takes it all the way for the dunk. Santa Clara extends the leadAnother Wildcats turnover leads to another Santa Clara bucket. It's 35-31 Broncos early in the second half. Kentucky has to have better shot selectionToo many times, the Wildcats haven't run a good offensive set and launched a 3-pointer instead. They have to work the ball inside and take advantage of their athleticism. Halftime: Santa Clara 31 - Kentucky 29The Wildcats took a lot of bad shots, and struggled to rebound. That leads to a halftime deficit. Santa Clara back to the leadAnother offensive rebound led to a foul, and they lead 31-29. Denzel Aberdeen hits a threeThat was a big one. The Wildcats are back up by three. Kentucky offense has stalledThe Wildcats have settled for mid-range jumpers and 3-point shots lately. Brandon Garrison was hot earlier. It might be good to get him involved again. Media timeout: Kentucky 26 - Santa Clara 23The Wildcats had a few sloppy turnovers over the past few minutes, and Otega Oweh missed a couple of shots. Kentucky still leads, though. Mouhamed Dioubate for threeSanta Clara cut into the lead with a 3, but Dioubate answers with one of his own. Denzel Aberdeen breakaway dunkOtega Oweh gets a steal and Aberdeen gets ahead of the pack for the dunk. It's 23-18 Kentucky. Highlight: Mouhamed Dioubate nice move Kentucky struggling to box outIt has been an issue all season. Kentucky gets outworked on the glass at times. Collin Chandler unable to hitKentucky needs Chandler to make some shots. So far, he's not getting the shots to fall. Media timeout: Kentucky 14 - Santa Clara 13The Wildcats lead, but need to tighten up the defense. Garrison has been solid, but they haven't gotten Oweh going yet. Brandon Garrison scores insideOtega Oweh makes a terrific pass of the screen and roll, and Garrison gets it to drop. Santa Clara takes the leadKentucky left a shooter open and he hits the three pointer. It's 11-10 Broncos. Santa Clara on a runKentucky got out to a 8-2 lead, but Collin Chandler has missed a couple of shots and the Broncos are on a 6-0 run to tied the game at 8-8. Santa Clara getting into the lane earlyBoth of the Broncos buckets came by driving into the lane. Kentucky will need to do a better job at rotating inside. Otega Oweh hits a three pointerDenzel Aberdeen and Otega Oweh both have early threes for the Wildcats. They lead 8-2. Malachi Moreno gets things startedKentucky got a couple of offensive rebounds on their opening possession and Moreno puts it back in for the game's first bucket.
